2845-sir-nigel.title: Sir Nigel
2845-sir-nigel.creator: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
2845-sir-nigel.description: A book by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. The matter of diction is always a question of taste and discretion in a historical reproduction. In the year 1350 the upper classes still spoke Norman-French, though they were just beginning to condescend to English. The lower classes spoke the English of the original Piers Plowman text, which would be considerably more obscure than their superiors’ French if the two were now reproduced or imitated.

57625-the-new-man-twenty-nine-years-a-sl.creator: Unknown
57625-the-new-man-twenty-nine-years-a-sl.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Freedom has been sweet indeed to the ex-bondman. It has been one glorious harvest of good things, and he fervently prays for grace to forget the past and for strength to go forward to resolutely meet the future.

arxiv-2011-11868.title: Topological violation of global symmetries in quantum gravity
arxiv-2011-11868.creator: Kazuya Yonekura
arxiv-2011-11868.description: Abstract We discuss a topological reason why global symmetries are not conserved in quantum gravity, at least when the symmetry comes from compactification of a higher form symmetry. The mechanism is purely topological and does not require any explicit breaking term in the UV Lagrangian.

arxiv-2109-10946.title: Marginals Versus Copulas: Which Account For More Model Risk In Multivariate Risk Forecasting?
arxiv-2109-10946.creator: Simon Fritzsch, Maike Timphus, Gregor Weiß
arxiv-2109-10946.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Simon Fritzsch, Maike Timphus, Gregor Weiß. We study the model risk of multivariate risk models in a comprehensive empirical study on Copula-GARCH models used for forecasting Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall. To determine whether model risk inherent in the forecasting of portfolio risk is caused by the candidate marginal or copula models, we analyze different groups of models in which we fix either the marginals, the copula, or neither.

arxiv-2110-00048.title: Collinear factorization of diphoton photoproduction at next to leading order
arxiv-2110-00048.creator: O. Grocholski, B. Pire, P. Sznajder, L. Szymanowski, J. Wagner
arxiv-2110-00048.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by O. Grocholski, B. Pire, P. Sznajder, L. Szymanowski, J. Wagner. We calculate in the framework of collinear factorization the amplitude for the photoproduction of a near forward large mass diphoton at leading twist and next to leading order (NLO) in α s \alpha_{s} . We demonstrate the validity of factorization at this order, which was never achieved for such a reaction where the coefficient function describes a 2 → 3 2\to 3 hard process.

arxiv-2203-05000.title: Notes on altermagnetism and superconductivity
arxiv-2203-05000.creator: Igor I. Mazin
arxiv-2203-05000.description: Abstract Altermagnetism is a recently discovered new type of collinear magnets, which share some characteristic features with ferromagnets (lack of the nonrelativistic Kramers degeneracy at a general point in the Brillouin zone, finite anomalous Hall effect, finite magnetooptical effect) and other with antiferromagnets (net magnetization zero by symmetry) AM .

arxiv-2304-04261.title: Impurities in quasi-one-dimensional droplets of binary Bose mixtures
arxiv-2304-04261.creator: Sudip Sinha, Sayak Biswas, L. Santos, S. Sinha
arxiv-2304-04261.description: Abstract Recently created self-bound quantum droplets of binary Bose mixtures open intriguing possibilities for the study of impurity physics. We show that the properties of impurities embedded in quasi-one-dimensional droplets are determined by the interplay between back-action and quantum fluctuations. Due to such back-action, repulsive impurities may form a metastable quasi-bound state inside the droplet.

arxiv-2308-01598.title: Meta-theorems for Parameterized Streaming Algorithms
arxiv-2308-01598.creator: Daniel Lokshtanov Pranabendu Misra Fahad Panolan M. S. Ramanujan, Saket Saurabh Meirav Zehavi
arxiv-2308-01598.description: Abstract The streaming model was introduced to parameterized complexity independently by Fafianie and Kratsch [MFCS14] and by Chitnis, Cormode, Hajiaghayi and Monemizadeh [SODA15]. Subsequently, it was broadened by Chitnis, Cormode, Esfandiari, Hajiaghayi and Monemizadeh [SPAA15] and by Chitnis, Cormode, Esfandiari, Hajiaghayi, McGregor, Monemizadeh and Vorotnikova [SODA16].

arxiv-2311-16435.title: Unique determination by a single far-field measurement for an inverse elastic problem
arxiv-2311-16435.creator: Huaian Diao, Ruixiang Tang, Hongyu Liu, Jiexin Tang
arxiv-2311-16435.description: Abstract . This paper is concerned with the unique identification of the shape of a scatterer through a single far-field pattern in an inverse elastic medium scattering problem with a generalized transmission boundary condition. The uniqueness issue by a single far-field measurement is a challenging problem in inverse scattering theory, which has a long and colorful history.

arxiv-2407-12280.title: Juhl type formulas for curved Ovsienko–Redou operators
arxiv-2407-12280.creator: Shane Chern, Zetian Yan
arxiv-2407-12280.description: Abstract . We prove Juhl type formulas for the curved Ovsienko–Redou operators and their linear analogues, which indicate the associated formal self-adjointness, thereby confirming two conjectures of Case, Lin, and Yuan. We also offer an extension of Juhl’s original formula for the GJMS operators. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 58J70; Secondary 53A40, 33C20 1.

arxiv-2412-11852.title: Towards advanced forecasting of solar energetic particle events with the PARASOL model
arxiv-2412-11852.creator: Alexandr Afanasiev, Nicolas Wijsen, Rami Vainio
arxiv-2412-11852.description: Abstract Gradual solar energetic particle (SEP) events are generally attributed to the particle acceleration in shock waves driven by coronal mass ejections (CMEs). Space-weather effects of such events are important, so there has been continuous effort to develop models able to forecast their various characteristics.

arxiv-2503-17952.title: SLIDE: Sliding Localized Information for Document Extraction
arxiv-2503-17952.creator: Divyansh Singh, Manuel Nunez Martinez, Sonja Schmer Galunder, Bonnie J. Dorr
arxiv-2503-17952.description: Abstract Constructing accurate knowledge graphs from long texts and low-resource languages is challenging, as large language models (LLMs) experience degraded performance with longer input chunks. This problem is amplified in low-resource settings where data scarcity hinders accurate entity and relationship extraction. Contextual retrieval methods, while improving retrieval accuracy, struggle with long documents.

arxiv-2506-12118.title: Real-Time Capable, Low-latency Upstream Scheduling in Multi-Tenant, SLA Compliant TWDM PON Journal: jocn
arxiv-2506-12118.creator: Arijeet Ganguli, Marco Ruffini
arxiv-2506-12118.description: Abstract Virtualized Passive Optical Networks (vPONs) offer a promising solution for modern access networks, bringing enhanced flexibility, reduced capital expenditures (CapEx), and support for multi-tenancy. By decoupling network functions from physical infrastructure, vPONs enable service providers to efficiently share network resources among multiple tenants.

arxiv-2510-08707.title: Neutrino signal from the hadron-quark phase transition in the conversion of Neutron Stars into Quark Stars
arxiv-2510-08707.creator: Yossef Zenati, Conrado Albertus Torres, Joseph Silk, M. Ángeles Pérez-García
arxiv-2510-08707.description: Abstract We calculate in a 1D General Relativistic (GR) hydrodynamic simulation the neutrino luminosity in an astrophysical scenario where a neutron star (NS) displays a hadron-quark phase transition (HQPT) into a Quark Star (QS). Deconfinement is triggered once the central density exceeds a critical threshold above ∼ 3 ​ n 0 \sim 3\,n_{0} being n 0 n_{0} , saturation density.

britannica-1911-meningitis.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-meningitis.description: Article 'Meningitis' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the brain (cerebral meningitis) or spinal cord (spinal meningitis) or both. Tubercular cerebral meningitis (or Acute Hydrocephalus) is a disease due to inflammation of the meninges of the brain produced by the presence of a tubercle bacillus. This disease is most common in children under ten years of age, but may affect adults. The tubercular constitution is an important factor in this malady.

pmc-10636157.creator: Niti Sarat, Amrita Salim, Sanjay Pal, Suja Subhash, Megha Prasad, Bipin G Nair, Ajith Madhavan
pmc-10636157.description: Wastewater malodour is the proverbial ‘elephant in the room’ notwithstanding its severe implications on sanitation, health, and hygiene. The predominant malodorous compounds associated with wastewater treatment plants and toilets are volatile organic compounds, such as hydrogen sulphide, ammonia, methanethiol, and organic acids. Among them, methanethiol warrants more attention owing to its relatively low olfactory threshold and associated cytotoxicity.

pmc-10735476.title: PRECARIOUS HOUSING BEFORE, DURING, AND AFTER AN EPISODE OF LATE-LIFE HOMELESSNESS

pmc-10735476.description: This qualitative study aims to understand how the living environments occupied by older adults before, during, and after an episode of homelessness inform their access to a healthy, stable, and dignified life. Indicators of accommodation, quality, and service integration are explored using the Aging in the Right Place conceptual framework.

pmc-11626373.creator: Konstantin Frank, Doris Day, Julius Few, Chhabra Chiranjiv, Michael Gold, Sonja Sattler, Martina Kerscher, Leonard Knoedler, Alexandre Filippo, Berthold Rzany, Sebastian Cotofana, Sabrina Fabi, Klaus Fritz, Peter Peng, Rungsima Wanitphakdeedecha, Rainer Pooth, Patrick Huang
pmc-11626373.description: BackgroundAesthetic medicine has traditionally relied on clinical scales for the objective assessment of baseline appearance and treatment outcomes. pmc-12499583.title: Successful management of recurrent multiple intracerebral TFE3-rearranged epithelioid hemangioendothelioma with repeated intervention and active surveillance: illustrative case
pmc-12499583.creator: Yasuzumi Matsui, Shigeki Takada, Yasuhide Takeuchi, Shinya Tokunaga, Etsuko Yamamoto Hattori, Hiroyuki Ikeda, Noritaka Sano, Masahiro Tanji, Yohei Mineharu, Yoshiki Arakawa
pmc-12499583.description: BACKGROUNDEpithelioid hemangioendothelioma (EHE) is a rare vascular tumor with intermediate malignant potential. TFE3-rearranged intracerebral EHEs (iEHEs) have not been reported to date. Herein, the authors describe a rare case of recurrent multiple TFE3-rearranged iEHEs involving the lung and liver, which exhibited a favorable clinical course after repeated surgeries, radiation therapy, and active surveillance.

pmc-12556189.title: How income, perception of scientists, and health literacy shape the use of non-conventional medicine
pmc-12556189.creator: M Duplaga
pmc-12556189.description: BackgroundThe use of non-conventional medicine (NCM) remains widespread, despite the lack of scientific evidence supporting its practices. This phenomenon raises public health concerns, particularly due to the risk of delayed access to appropriate treatment. The main aim of this study was to analyze the determinants of NCM services utilization.

pmc-13517543.creator: Paul K. J. Park, Junseok Kim, Juhyun Ko
pmc-13517543.description: Highlights What are the main findings? This review presents a sensor-oriented taxonomy of hybrid event–frame sensing architectures and systems, including dual-camera event–frame systems, optically aligned event–frame systems, pixel-level shared hybrid image sensors, stacked CIS–DVS hybrid image sensors, homogeneous-pixel sensing systems, and event-only reconstruction systems.

pmc-13610891.title: Performance of Multi-Gradient Biomimetic POSS-Toughened CFRP Laminates with a Pearl-Inspired Hard-Soft Interfacial Architecture
pmc-13610891.creator: Gefeng Xiang, Shuwei Sun, Yujie Wang, Baorui Jia, Changqing Li, Mingli Qin
pmc-13610891.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Carbon-fiber-reinforced epoxy (CFRP) composites are widely used in aerospace structures because of their high specific strength and modulus; however, matrix cracking and interlaminar delamination induced by low-velocity impact compromise their structural safety. To overcome the difficulty of simultaneously improving interfacial strength and impact resistance through uniform nanomodification, a pearl-inspired gradient interfacial architecture incorporating a through-thickness distribution of polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (POSS) was developed and compared with unmodified and uniformly modified CFRP laminates.
